propositions: The host updater currently uses unlocked pipx VCS resolution which bypasses the committed uv.lock and Click security override.
The updater must be changed to check out exact SHAs from git ls-remote and run uv sync --locked with runtime/operator extras to preserve lock determinism and security constraints.
After successful candidate build and smoke test, the updater must atomically publish only the passing release and retain no rejected candidates or superseded versions.
The updater must preserve repository pyproject.toml and uv.lock unchanged and verify Click 8.4.2 is installed with no PYSEC-2026-2132 vulnerability in the published runtime.
Machine-local launchd-triggered installs must idempotently verify the exact remote SHA and log no-op on subsequent runs without advancing the version.
